title: WA Recovery Pro v2.0.1 — Floating Quick Preview & Android 14 Single-Use Token Fix
changelog: 📸 Floating Quick Preview: Instant interactive thumbnail popup attached to the bubble after capturing screenshot
🛡️ Black Frame Filter: 25-point matrix validation ignores black/dark GPU frames and skips protected screens
🎥 Fresh Token Video Recording: Compliant with Android 14 single-use token lifecycle to eliminate SecurityException
📤 FileProvider Notification Sharing: Seamless screenshot preview and direct sharing from system notification
